create_tag_insert_new_tag: create a tag by calling insert_new_tag with a name and user_id to store it in the database
read_tag_get_tag_by_name_and_user_id: read a tag by calling get_tag_by_name_and_user_id with a name and user_id to retrieve it from the database
read_tags_get_tags_by_user_id: read all tags by calling get_tags_by_user_id with a user_id to list tags for that user
read_tags_get_tags_by_ids_and_user_id: read specific tags by calling get_tags_by_ids_and_user_id with a list of ids and user_id
delete_tag_delete_tag_by_name_and_user_i: delete a tag by calling delete_tag_by_name_and_user_id with a name and user_id to remove it from the database
